# `fp` standard library

The `fp` module provides generic higher-order combinators, function composition utilities,
and functional collection helpers.

```dva
#use fp
// or import directly into unqualified scope:
#use(import) fp
```

## Function combinators

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fp::apply` | `(T => U), T => U` | Applies function `f` to argument `x` (`f $ x`) |
| `fp::apply2` | `(T, U => V), T, U => V` | Applies binary function `f(a, b)` |
| `fp::twice` | `(T => T), T => T` | Applies `f` twice: `f(f(x))` |
| `fp::thrice` | `(T => T), T => T` | Applies `f` three times: `f(f(f(x)))` |
| `fp::flip` | `(T, U => V), U, T => V` | Swaps the arguments of a binary function |
| `fp::compose` | `(B => C), (A => B) => (A => C)` | Curried function composition: `f(g(x))` |
| `fp::const` | `A => (B => A)` | Constant combinator: ignores second argument |
| `fp::on` | `(T, T => V), (T => T), T, T => V` | Applies unary transform to both arguments before binary combination |

```dva
add_ten = fp::compose(x => x + 5, x => x + 5)
result = add_ten(10) // 20
```

## Collection combinators

The collection combinators operate on homogeneous records and growable array types:

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `fp::map(f, xs)` | Maps unary function `f` over each element of `xs` |
| `fp::filter(p, xs)` | Returns elements satisfying predicate `p` |
| `fp::foldl(f, init, xs)` | Left associative fold over elements |
| `fp::foldr(f, init, xs)` | Right associative fold over elements |
| `fp::any(p, xs)` | Checks if at least one element satisfies predicate `p` |
| `fp::all(p, xs)` | Checks if all elements satisfy predicate `p` |
| `fp::sum(xs)` | Calculates the numeric sum of elements |
| `fp::product(xs)` | Calculates the numeric product of elements |
| `fp::find(p, xs)` | Finds the first element satisfying predicate `p`, returning `RamPN` `< E | >` |
